summary: Physical N71 kernel #4 verified EE then two E3/D9 handshakes and one Type-1 E7 D9 descriptor fetch. SPI rc=0, E7 reply, checksum matched. Signed axis endpoints showed inverse Y direction and spans approximately 5.8k x 10.4k raw units, aspect ratio within 0.1% of physical 750x1334 screen. Prior RFC9 erroneously rejected reversed Y; AF not sent. GPIO142 IRQ remained 1, no EVDEV events; new RFC10 remains offline-only. Device-specific exact bounds and firmware never published.
